description: Named multi-county geographic regions in Texas. Used to inject the canonical member-county list as factual context whenever a user query references a named region. Regions are objective geography (e.g., the Texas Panhandle is a defined cultural-geographic region, the Permian Basin is a defined oil-and-gas basin). The county lists are documentation, not query-routing rules.

texas_panhandle.description: Northern-most Texas counties, prone to wildfire and severe weather.

permian_basin.description: Texas oil-and-gas producing basin in West Texas; ERCOT-dependent industrial corridor.

tx_mexico_border.description: Texas counties along the U.S.-Mexico border from El Paso to Cameron.

dallas_tarrant.description: Core Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex (Dallas County + Tarrant County).

tx_major_metros.description: Five largest Texas metropolitan counties (used for 'outside major metros' filtering).

gulf_coast_generation.description: Texas Gulf-coast counties hosting major thermal and nuclear generation assets.
